C1.text: On text-rich ultra-sparse Amazon benchmarks (Office N=3,459, Industrial N=3,686, Beauty N=12,101), removing free item ID embeddings in a full-D L2-normalized sequential model (fullD noID+L2) beats fullD ID+unnorm on R@200 Tail across all 3 datasets (3 seeds each) and beats 3-seed TIGER on Beauty at all 5 matched tau in {0..1} (3/3 seeds paired 95% CI > 0).
C1.kill: fullD ID+unnorm or TIGER matches or beats fullD noID+L2 on R@200 Tail across Amazon Beauty/Office/Industrial at matched tau=0
C1.scope: Amazon Office/Industrial/Beauty (N<=12,101, text-rich sparse tail); excludes dense-tail text-weak regimes such as MicroLens-100K
